_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. ⚑ D23's AMBIENT NPC and the one D18 exists for: it calls out as you walk past AND opens a tree on E; its `ambient` lines are the only ones in the game, so they are also the regression test for walk-by speech. ⚑ QUESTS: the crier OFFERS `wolves-on-the-road` but turns in NOTHING — that is D9's branch, finished east by either the CityGuard or the Shaman for different rewards; his quest brief is where the player learns there is a choice (written directions, no marker, GDD 8). ⚑ Q4 (conversation-journal §4.6): the Damage teaching is GONE — Damage is a level-1 milestone seeded at character creation now — so the teachings node holds only Recall. R1 shape: greeting at root, the quest behind its own row with its brief as that node's text; NO quest_at_stage gates (the Q1 show-rule hides the Accept row once taken), which also retires the quest-conditional greeting hijack plan-quests.md §15 recorded against this NPC.
name: TownCrier

ambient: Wolves on the forest road! Travel armed or not at all!
The militia wants word of every attack — east, to the city!

lines: You there! Good. Somebody who still walks toward trouble instead of away from it.

options.text: Who else should I speak to?

lines: Wolves. Out of the forest, onto the road, bolder every week.
Eight of them thinned out, then word east to the militia at the city gate — or to the shaman's fire by the road, if the whole walk is more than you fancy.

grants.line: Eight. Eight and the road is walkable again — then east with the word, and let somebody with a banner decide what it means.

lines: The militia holds the gate, and the gate is where the orcs are.
The road between is the village's problem. Which is to say: yours.
The farmer, if you want to eat. The keeper of the fire east of here, if you want to survive the dark.
Neither will thank you for the visit. Go anyway.
I can spare what a newcomer needs. No more than that.

grants.line: The city needs to hear of these wolf attacks! Take this so you can find your way back.
